$comment: Artconomy's per-submission choices, mirroring the site's own upload form. Values are strings, as for every post option. Journals (posts with no image) take only DisableComments.

CreditAsArtist.label: Credit me as the artist
CreditAsArtist.help: Choose No for art you didn't make: it goes to your collection instead of your gallery.

Private.label: Private
Private.help: Image posts only. Hides the submission from everyone but you and people you share it with.
